verdict.rationale: uv is itself an official first-party CLI. A full CLI reference is documented (uv-probe-4), with rich command coverage: init, add, remove, lock, run, tool, python, cache, self update, build and publish. Agent-friendly touches include `--output-format json` and shell autocompletion. Community users independently praise the 'more ergonomic CLI' and replacing CI YAML with `uv build`/`uv publish`. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable (JSON) output across commands beyond `uv version`, and any documented non-interactive or agent-specific usage guidance.
